title: Autoloader subsystem (static attributes)
description: Static attributes of an autoloader: the mechanical loading stage in seconds, its concurrency and its sounds. Stock and regeneration belong to the ammo rack model (regen_ammo_rack_static_attr.schema.json); service channels are per-instance fields, see dynamic/ammo_loader_dynamic_attr.schema.json.

$schema.description: Path of this JSON Schema, used for editor completion and validation.

basic_durability.description: Durability limit. Reaching zero only stops loading: the rack's stock is untouched and no cook-off happens. It recovers at 30% of the limit.

pass_damage.description: Whether damage is passed on to the subsystem host. First-party definitions write false: the loader absorbs hits itself.

limit_damage.description: Whether passed damage is limited to the remaining subsystem durability.

hidden.description: Whether the subsystem is hidden from the HUD.

reload_time.description: Base duration of the mechanical stage in seconds. Must be greater than 0: a zero-length stage counts as unconfigured, and an autoloader without a mechanical stage cannot express any loading path, so decoding rejects it.

can_supply_multiple.description: Concurrency. false = one job holds the only slot (exclusive, full speed); true = unlimited slots, each job at full speed. Stock is always shared through the upstream rack.

progress_sounds.description: Progress markers of the mechanical stage: keys are decimal strings '0.0'..'1.0', values the sound played at that progress. A single advance that crosses several markers plays each of them in ascending order.

fmod.description: Optional FMOD event reference for the mechanical stage. Playback wiring is not implemented yet.

sounds.description: Basic sounds plus the progress markers of the mechanical stage.
